seoTitle: Meta Tag Analyzer for Public Pages
metaDescription: Inspect the title, description, canonical, robots directives and social metadata in a public page’s HTML.
intro: Inspect the title, description, canonical, robots directives and social metadata in a public page’s HTML.
aboutTitle: What can I see in a metadata scan?
about: The analyzer fetches the HTML served by a public URL and reports metadata declared there. Use the report to find missing tags, compare canonical targets and review Open Graph fields.
exampleTitle: Check a metadata change after publishing
example: Scan the published article, then compare its reported title, description and canonical with the values in your CMS. If they differ, check the deployed template and cache.

faqs.question: Will the preview match Google exactly?
faqs.answer: The preview estimates how the metadata may look. Google can select a different title link or snippet for a particular search.
